rawErrorFindings.summary: Creator dashboard managers displayed raw load or mutation route messages.
Wallet purchase UI used provider problem strings directly instead of HumanErrorNotice.
Creator Dashboard settings load failures could display raw route errors and oversized mobile cards.
Creator Dashboard landing module warnings could concatenate creator settings with raw internal server errors.

fixesApplied: Added a client error adapter for thrown errors, route payloads, HTTP status, safe previous routes, and bug report context.
Replaced creator dashboard manager route/action error displays with HumanErrorNotice and Send bug CTAs.
Added translated payment UI error rendering in the wallet purchase modal without changing PayPal route logic or GumDrop math.
Added optional translated action error rendering to CreatorExperiencesPanel for booking/request/Fan Pass/chat failures supplied by its owner.
Wired CreatorDashboardSettingsHub settings load failures through HumanErrorNotice with sanitized bug report context.
Added compact mobile Creator Dashboard density and bottom-nav-safe spacing markers in CreatorDashboardSettingsHub.
Wired CreatorWorkspacePanel settings module failures through HumanErrorNotice and routed Creator settings to the operations workspace.

deferredFindings.reason: The profile client owns the async creator action callbacks and toast handling, but it was not in the allowed file list for this pass.
Locked preview already maps unlock errors through product copy; full HumanErrorNotice replacement should be a focused drop-surface pass.
Public discovery and route code were left untouched to avoid entitlement/payment logic changes.
Chat has a large persistence and realtime surface; only a focused chat pass should replace composer toasts with HumanErrorNotice.

nextFixOrder: Keep CreatorDashboardSettingsHub settings errors on HumanErrorNotice; raw route payloads belong in Debug/admin only.
Wire CreatorProfileClient async creator action failures into CreatorExperiencesPanel actionError.
Replace locked drop preview unlock toasts with HumanErrorNotice in a drop-only pass.
Replace chat shell/composer error trays with HumanErrorNotice in a chat-only pass.
